title: Calming the Storm Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Calming of the Storm Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Calming the Storm Bible crossword: the ship on Galilee, the pillow, “Peace, be still,” and the great calm. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: They take him in the ship as he was, a great storm of wind rises, and the waves beat into the boat — and he is asleep in the hinder part, on a pillow. Calming the Storm turns Mark 4 into a grid: the rebuke to the wind, the three words to the sea, the great calm, and the question the disciples ask each other afterwards.
The pillow is the detail most retellings drop and the one this puzzle keeps, because it is the point. The closing verse is the rebuke itself.

clues.text: Sea where the great storm of wind arose
He was asleep in the hinder part of the ship on it
What followed the rebuke — a great one

verseText: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
